name: Subculture workboot
summary: The lace-up leather workboot turned youth badge. It has a smooth calf shaft, eight to fourteen eyelets, a yellow welt stitch and a thick air-cushioned sole. Skinheads, punks and others wear it.

philosophy.core_thesis: A work boot on a young foot is a signal of class and group. It is heavy, plain, cheap and hard to damage. The owner wears it to show that he or she belongs.
design_principles: Cut the shaft from smooth calf of 2 mm, and lace it with 8 to 14 eyelets.
Stitch the welt with a yellow thread that shows against the black sole.
Mould the sole in an air-cushioned form 3 to 4 cm thick, with a grooved tread.
Add a pull loop at the heel, and a scripted tag on the loop.
Add a steel toe cap under the leather, or leave the toe plain.
Polish the leather to a hard shine, or scuff it on purpose.
Lace the boot in a set pattern; the lace colour marks the group.

silhouette.shape: A thick boot: a rounded toe, a straight shaft to the ankle or the calf, and a heavy sole.
silhouette.line: A strong, flat horizontal line at the sole, and a high, tight shaft.
silhouette.fit: Firm at the ankle, laced tight; the toe box is roomy and round.
silhouette.proportion: Sole 3 to 4 cm; shaft 15 to 30 cm; 8 to 14 eyelets.
rules: Keep the toe round and the sole thick.
Lace the boot tight and evenly.
Wear the boot with the trouser turned up to show it.

fabrics.rule: Use a hard-wearing chrome-tanned calf for the upper, a moulded rubber sole, and a pressed steel toe cap for the work version. Keep the cloth to a canvas lining.

methods: Goodyear welt with a yellow thread
hand lasting over a round last
construction.closures: Flat or round laces through 8 to 14 eyelets, with a hook or metal eyelet at the top.
construction.details: A yellow welt stitch, a heel pull loop, a grooved sole, a rounded toe cap, a smooth or an arcadia grain leather.

surface.pattern: Plain, in black, oxblood or cherry; a scuffed, cut or painted surface for display.
surface.gloss: Smooth leather at 15–40 GU; patent at 80–90 GU.
surface.wear: The boot looks best broken in: a creased shaft and a scuffed toe cap are part of the style.

palette.strategy: Black, oxblood and cherry red, with a yellow stitch and a white or red lace.

processes: moulding the sole in a mould
making.scale: Factory made in the thousands, in a plain range with the same last for many years.
making.signs: A yellow welt stitch, a grooved sole, a heel loop, a round toe and a thick leather upper.

emotion.target_response: A feeling of toughness and belonging: a heavy, plain boot that shows loyalty and class.

modifiers.how: Thin the sole, narrow the toe, polish the calf and remove the yellow stitch.
Add a 6 cm platform, brighten the leather to a bold colour, and add stars or stripes.

ornament_level.note: Ornament is a stitch, a lace or a sticker; nothing is embroidered.
